main.summary: Verify signed `DataFieldAssertion` artifacts using explicit certificates or resolver-style certificate lookups.
main.remarks: Verification is intentionally limited to canonical assertion-data validation, time evaluation, thumbprint binding, and signature verification. Purpose remains informational and does not participate in verification success or failure.

method.name: TryValidateData
method.summary: Validate structural and invariant rules for canonical assertion data.
method.returns: True when required fields and invariants are satisfied; otherwise false.

method.name: TryValidateEvaluation
method.summary: Validate the time-bound rules of canonical assertion data for a specific evaluation instant.
method.returns: True when the assertion is valid at the evaluation instant; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyArtifact
method.summary: Verify a parsed `DataFieldAssertion` artifact using an explicitly supplied certificate and evaluation time.
method.param: Certificate used to verify the signature and thumbprint binding.
Output verified canonical assertion data when verification succeeds.
method.returns: True when the artifact verified successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyBytes
method.summary: Verify serialized signed field assertion bytes using an explicitly supplied certificate and evaluation time.
method.param: Certificate used to verify the signature and thumbprint binding.
method.returns: True when the serialized artifact parsed and verified successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyArtifactResolver
method.summary: Verify a parsed `DataFieldAssertion` artifact using a resolver-style certificate lookup keyed by `IssuerObjectId`.
method.param: Resolver that returns the issuer certificate for a given issuer object identifier.
method.returns: True when the artifact verified successfully through the resolver; otherwise false.

method.name: TryVerifyBytesResolver
method.summary: Verify serialized signed field assertion bytes using a resolver-style certificate lookup keyed by `IssuerObjectId`.
method.param: Resolver that returns the issuer certificate for a given issuer object identifier.
method.returns: True when the serialized artifact verified successfully through the resolver; otherwise false.
